Ask HN: Anyone using AI agents with SCPI equipment?
items.summary: I upgraded my home hobby electronics bench with equipment using SCPI (Standard Commands for Programmable Instruments). Looking for others' experiences and suggestions. So far I was able to: - produce a desktop graph of multimeter V DC readings (a kind of slow oscilloscope) using a LABLOOT LB1041 DMM - set a scope up to decode UART, using a SIGLENT SDS814X - set output voltage on a bench power supply, using an OWON SPS6051 - load arbitrary waveforms into a signal generator using a OWON DGE2045. What are others using SCPI for and are you allowing coding agents to write code to do useful things?
